items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: I never, I never seen him play in the band, he always was a teacher.

ctx.x: But did he, was he ever a member of a band?
No, I don't remember no, he was a member of no band. Yeah. No. No, no, no, no, no, no band. I never, I never seen him play in the band, he always was a teacher.
Oh, yeah. Who was that saxophone player up there that was a barber? Way, way back. You told Bill about him once. Uh, was a barber?
